blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Environmental groups are urging governments to place greater emphasis on reducing waste at the source, saying that improved waste collection and recycling alone cannot address the environmental impact of excessive production and consumption. The call came with the launch of a new framework at the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye, on Nov. 16, which seeks to establish a common way to identify and classify reuse practices across products and packaging. The Global Alliance for Incinerator Alternatives (GAIA) and the Break Free From Plastic (BFFP) movement said the framework is intended to help policymakers, […]...
